app.title: E-Paper Studio
app.description: Prepare images for Gicisky e-paper tags and send them over Bluetooth.
tags.title: Tag
tags.empty: Press “Scan” with the tag near the server.
tags.none_found: No Gicisky tag showed up. Move it closer to the adapter and scan again.
tags.configured: Configured tag: {address}. Press “Scan” to find it.
image.title: Image
image.drop_hint: or click · you can also paste it with Ctrl+V
presets.title: Starting point
coverage.title: Pigment coverage
preview.empty: Tap here or drop an image to start
hint.image: Drag the image to frame it · scroll or pinch to zoom · double-click a control to reset it
hint.data: Each line is one row as it travels: {row_bytes} bytes in hex · darker means more ink · red marks split the {block}-byte blocks
timing: framing and tone {prepare} ms · dithering {quantize} ms
control.auto_levels.help: Stretches the histogram so the darkest point becomes black and the lightest white.
control.gamma.help: Above 1 lightens the midtones without blowing out the whites.
control.sharpen.help: Dithering softens edges; a little sharpening makes up for it.
control.hue.help: Rotates the colours. Positive values move purples and pinks towards red.
control.color_bias.help: How much red is preferred over black or white when the choice is close.
control.color_weight.help: High: only clearly red areas become red. Low: mid greys get tinted.
control.serpentine.help: Alternates direction on every row to avoid diagonal streaks.
control.compress_range.help: Maps white to the paper and black to the ink so whites stay clean.
packet.att: ATT header: write without response (0x52) and the fef2 handle
packet.header: Block number, 4 bytes, least significant first
packet.reply: Tag notification on fef1: asks for the next block
